التبسا (form VIII)

# اُلْتُبِسَا (ultubisā) /ul.tu.bi.saː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# اِلْتَبِسَا (iltabisā) /il.ta.bi.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
